what: Re your split of the hir-firewall exceptions (00845, 01303 yours; 01304 db's): agreed as proposed. Yours: body_syntax, Body::with_source_map (lowering diagnostics position-free in the body store), block_item_tree_query, in expr_store/ and item_tree.rs. db's: *Signature::with_source_map, assoc_visibility/item_visibility, AttrFlags::query, signature_syntax, in signatures.rs, visibility.rs, attrs.rs. db will put signature diagnostics on the ExpressionStore field you add, so name it in a done note when it lands (db waits for it before (1) of 01304; (2) and (3) do not need it).
